resources.string: Choose a saved library, then the folder containing its exported article-text index. Only matching trusted index profiles packaged with this app are supported. The index is copied once into private storage and verified; your source files and previous indexes are preserved.
Open a library first. No saved sources were changed.
No matching trusted index profile is packaged for this library. Current profiles cover the small Knots, full English Wikipedia, and Medicine archives only. Title browsing remains available.
No folder picker is available. Existing content and indexes were preserved.
Index selection cancelled. Existing content and indexes were preserved.
Copying and verifying the index into private storage. Keep this screen open. Large indexes can take a while.
The index could not be installed. Check the exact trusted export, available private storage, and source access. Existing content and previous indexes were preserved.
